intro: The A.O. Smith X9 is a premium 100% RO water purifier designed to deliver Baby-Safe drinking water with advanced Silver Shield Technology. Equipped with a Copper Fortified Mineraliser, Alkaline Technology, and an intuitive Digital Display, it enhances water with essential minerals while maintaining a fresh, natural taste. Suitable for borewell, tanker, and mixed water sources, the X9 combines elegant design with powerful purification for healthier everyday hydration.
